record.name: Colombia
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A bill filed in July 2026 would make the science ministry the national AI authority, with an advisory council and regulatory sandboxes.

next_check.reason: Routine yearly re-check of a state where an institute is plausible (in Europe, the G20 or the OECD, or a signatory of the Bletchley Declaration).

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

News search from 17 October 2026 in English and Spanish, with the Minciencias news listing (newest 10 November). No qualifying item was found. Compute, data and application cooperation and a report by TheIntelligent of 30 October on AI-assisted cyberdefence do not assign advanced-model evaluation. The cyberdefence launch was not confirmed by an official source and was not used. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. check.governance_note: MinTIC's published AI security and privacy guidelines define technical, organisational and regulatory controls for AI systems.

related_bodies.name: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación
related_bodies.role: It would be the national AI authority under the bill, with a policy and regulatory role; it would not be a model evaluation institute.

record.notes:
The national AI policy CONPES 4144 (February 2025) was not read directly.

MinTIC published AI information-security and privacy guidelines aligned with CONPES 4144/2025 for public entities. Enactment of the July 2026 AI bill was not verified in the retrieved sources. The guidelines set technical, organisational and regulatory directions. Searches covered indexed public English and Spanish sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
